title: Essence Moraira
name: Essence
sub: A collection of four Mediterranean villas by Pepe Giner, above Teulada-Moraira.
thesis_h: Four architect-designed villas, each its own house.
thesis_lede: Essence is a small development of four homes by architect José Giner Ivars on the hillside above Moraira, minutes from the sea. Warm stone, travertine and glass; open-plan living that runs to a private pool and the Mediterranean beyond. Every villa here is shown in the architect's own renders.

villas.name: Villa I
villas.blurb: The travertine villa — two low volumes over a pool terrace, framed by pine. A double-height living space opens fully to the water; the master suite sits above, private and quiet.

villas.name: Villa II
villas.blurb: The stone villa — a long horizontal mass in local stone and warm wood, stepping down its plot to the pool. Living, kitchen and dining run as one continuous, sunlit room.

villas.name: Villa III
villas.blurb: The sculptural villa — floating roof planes and a full-width terrace holding the view low and wide. Inside, a sculptural stair rises through a stone-and-glass double height.

villas.name: Villa IV
villas.blurb: Essence Patio — the largest home, set on its own near-4,000 m² green plot with a reflecting water garden. Shaded pergolas and a wrapping terrace make the outdoors the main room.

foot_h: Essence Moraira — four villas, one hillside, brought to life before a stone is laid.
twin_note: Renders and floorplans are the developer's own, by architect José Giner Ivars, presented here by Hansson & Hertzell as sales agent. Built and plot areas are builder-stated from the Essence Moraira microsite.
